policies.name: tenants_runtime
policies.using: ((id = current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true)) OR (storage_key = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)) OR (current_setting('app.platform'::text, true) = '1'::text))

policies.name: memberships_runtime
policies.check:
((tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true)) OR (current_setting('app.platform'::text, true) = '1'::text) OR (tenant_id IN ( SELECT tenants.id
   FROM gymos.tenants
  WHERE (tenants.storage_key = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)))))
policies.using:
((user_id = current_setting('app.actor'::text, true)) OR (tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true)) OR (current_setting('app.platform'::text, true) = '1'::text) OR (tenant_id IN ( SELECT tenants.id
   FROM gymos.tenants
  WHERE (tenants.storage_key = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)))))

policies.name: licenses_read
policies.using:
((tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true)) OR (current_setting('app.platform'::text, true) = '1'::text) OR (tenant_id IN ( SELECT tenants.id
   FROM gymos.tenants
  WHERE (tenants.storage_key = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)))))

policies.name: licenses_pending
policies.check:
((tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant'::text, true)) AND (status = 'pending'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM gymos.tenant_memberships m
  WHERE ((m.tenant_id = tenant_licenses.tenant_id) AND (m.user_id = current_setting('app.actor'::text, true)) AND (m.role = 'owner'::text) AND (NOT m.revoked)))))

policies.name: plans_read
policies.using:
(published OR (current_setting('app.platform'::text, true) = '1'::text) OR (id IN ( SELECT tenant_licenses.plan_id
   FROM gymos.tenant_licenses)))

policies.name: member_portal_update
policies.check: ((owner_id = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)) OR ((user_id = current_setting('app.actor'::text, true)) AND (invite_hash IS NULL) AND (NOT revoked)))
policies.using: ((owner_id = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)) OR ((user_id IS NULL) AND (invite_hash = current_setting('app.member_invite'::text, true)) AND (NOT revoked) AND (expires_at > now())))

policies.name: member_portal_read
policies.using: ((owner_id = current_setting('app.gym_owner'::text, true)) OR ((user_id = current_setting('app.actor'::text, true)) AND (NOT revoked)) OR ((invite_hash = current_setting('app.member_invite'::text, true)) AND (NOT revoked) AND (expires_at > now())))

policies.name: member_code_login
policies.using:
((code_hash = current_setting('app.member_code'::text, true)) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM gymos.member_code_sessions s
  WHERE ((s.owner_id = member_code_access.owner_id) AND (s.member_id = member_code_access.member_id) AND (s.session_hash = current_setting('app.member_session'::text, true)) AND (s.expires_at > now())))))
